title: Proper inpaint + object removal - evaluate Klein 4B vs Qwen-Edit removal LoRAs
description:
Vision has NO object-removal capability (repo grep for 'outpaint' = zero hits). Krea2 already outpaints well, so the real gap is REMOVAL (tattoos, watermarks, unwanted objects) and mask-driven inpaint. Two candidate paths evaluated on the bench 2026-07-26.

PATH A - FLUX.2 Klein 4B + fal green-screen outpaint LoRA (Apache-2.0, all weights downloaded to G:/CubricModels). VERIFIED WORKING: object removal, masked replacement, outpaint. Distilled 8-step beats base 50-step on BOTH speed (20s vs 154s) and fill detail (lap-var 19.6 vs 16.0) - base is over-guided at cfg 4.0, same pathology as the Krea2 cfg finding. Crop-and-stitch (InpaintCropImproved/InpaintStitchImproved, mask_blend_pixels 32) cut the seam gradient 6x, 14.56 -> 2.44. Cost: +16.2GB user download (7.75GB ckpt + 8.04GB qwen_3_4b encoder + 0.34GB VAE + 0.076GB LoRA).

PATH B - Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (ALREADY SHIPPED) + a dedicated removal LoRA. Three Apache-2.0 removal LoRAs exist on 2511; zero new base model. User tested Qwen at 4-step Lightning: 66s cold and it DESTROYED skin texture. Unfair comparison though - Klein ran 8 steps. The 8-step Lightning LoRA is ALREADY on disk, untested. Full-model Qwen run was in flight at session end (user estimate ~380-400s).

OPEN BLOCKER on both paths: the fill's colour statistics drift from surrounding pixels (measured +5.8R/-3.2G/-11.4B on skin). Model-inherent - nothing ties fill stats to the ring, so step count and cfg do not touch it. kjnodes ColorMatch makes it WORSE (10.60 -> 15.09 mkl, -> 20.66 hm) because its reference crop still CONTAINS the object being removed, pulling the fill toward it. A ring-only mean shift fixes it (10.60 -> 0.93, 11x) but needs a node that does not exist. User has instructions for MpiNodes work not yet given - DO NOT start node work without them.
outcome: DECIDED: Klein wins, becomes a model (-> MPI-354). Qwen path CLOSED - measured on the user tattoo image, grain in the edited region was 49%/54%/52% of real skin at 4/8/20 steps vs Klein 56% at 8 steps, so 409s of full-model Qwen buys nothing over 103s and never reaches Klein. The handoff hypothesis "8-step notably beats 4-step on texture" is DISPROVEN (+0.13 grain). Removal LoRAs never downloaded - they change WHAT is removed, not texture, so they could not have rescued the path. Klein is 5-20x faster at equal-or-better texture.
